title: He was struck by lightning 7 times #truestory #shorts
description: Shenandoah National Park ranger Roy Sullivan survived seven recorded lightning strikes between 1942 and 1977; Guinness World Records lists him for the most lightning strikes survived. Sources: Guinness World Records, Wikipedia, Mental Floss.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: This park ranger was struck by lightning seven times. And survived every single one.
scenes.title: STRUCK 7 TIMES

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: Roy Sullivan was a ranger in Shenandoah National Park in Virginia.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: In nineteen forty two, he ran out of a burning lookout tower, and a bolt hit his leg and burned a hole in his shoe.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: In nineteen seventy two, lightning got him inside a ranger station and set his hair on fire.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: He got hit in his own front yard, on a trail, and finally, in nineteen seventy seven, while fishing.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: Guinness World Records says nobody has survived more lightning strikes. People called him the Human Lightning Rod.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: Would you ever go outside in a storm again?
